title: Read the final line parameters
description: You inspect how the stored slope and bias appear in the final report.

steps.description: You reach a report of the final m and b values. The comment identifies the two parameters this block displays.

steps.question: How many digits after the decimal point does each parameter show?
steps.answer: The .4f format shows four digits after the decimal point.

steps.description: You print the current parameters after a leading newline. This statement reads m and b without updating them.
You see m=2.0000 and b=1.0000 in the recording. These are the displayed slope and bias of the learned line.
